verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a no-code Pipelines workflow designer UI for building ingestion/RAG workflows, which implies some GUI-based interaction without code, but there is no explicit evidence of a lightweight web playground where a developer simply drags in a single document and immediately sees parse/extract output before writing any code — the quickstarts instead emphasize Python/API/SDK usage to get from file to structured output in minutes. missing for 10: explicit playground/drag-and-drop demo evidence, screenshots or docs describing instant single-file preview without any setup or code.
